name: bug-4-thread-never-joined
why: bug 4: the std::thread is destroyed while it is joinable: std::terminate.

name: sum-detached
why: the thread is detached: the sum is read while the thread may still be writing it.

name: sum-joined-too-late
why: a jthread that joins when the function ends: the result is read (and copied) BEFORE the join.

name: worker-stop-does-not-join

name: worker-stop-twice-crashes

name: bug-6-exception-escapes-the-thread
